name: PharmVar (Pharmacogene Variation Consortium)
scope: Haplotype (star allele) definitions per pharmacogene with sequence-level variants in VCF, FASTA and TSV downloads; API services are offered for third parties.
mapping_methods: Positions given on locus reference sequences (RefSeqGene/LRG) and genome builds.
